# Aria Kianzad

> Aria Kianzad is a brand strategist and personal branding consultant working across research, positioning, brand identity and communication.

Canonical website: https://ariakianzad.github.io/

## Professional focus

Aria helps brands turn research and insight into a distinct position, then translate that thinking into identity and communication people can understand, remember and choose.

Core areas of work:
- Brand strategy and positioning
- Consumer insight and market research
- Competitive and category analysis
- Brand identity development and verbal identity
- Content strategy and brand storytelling
- Copywriting and SEO content strategy
- Personal branding

## Website sections

- Perspective: clarity, relevance and communicating with intention rather than volume.
- Expertise: research and insight, positioning and identity, content and communication.
- Method: listen, investigate, position and express.
- Rexo: an independent creative agency founded by Aria Kianzad in 2024, connecting brand strategy with creative execution.
- Writing: Aria's first-party Persian/English editorial blog, plus selected external publications.
- About and contact: professional background and direct contact.

## Personal blog

The personal blog is the primary home for Aria's long-form writing on brand strategy, positioning, identity, communication and personal branding. Articles are published as static, crawlable pages in Persian and English.

- Blog archive: https://ariakianzad.github.io/blog/
- RSS feed: https://ariakianzad.github.io/blog/feed.xml
- Collaboration and editorial enquiries: https://ariakianzad.github.io/blog/contact/

The blog has its own editorial category pages, article metadata, canonical URLs, Open Graph and X cards, Article/BlogPosting structured data, and a sitemap containing indexable published pages. Only published snapshots are included in the public static build.

## Persian book

Aria Kianzad is the author of the Persian book «میانِ ما», published by مجله رکسو. It explores relationships, emotional intimacy, commitment, communication and emotional responsibility.

- Book page: https://ariakianzad.github.io/Mian-e-Ma/
- Direct PDF: https://ariakianzad.github.io/Mian-e-Ma/assets/Mian-e-Ma.pdf
- Language: Persian (fa-IR)
- Publisher: مجله رکسو
- Author: آریا کیانزاد

## Structured information

The personal website provides Schema.org WebSite, ProfilePage, Person and Organization entities.
The book page provides Book and FAQ structured data.

## Technical notes

The personal website is a static Next.js export hosted on GitHub Pages, with no Next.js hydration runtime.
The 3D hero uses a same-origin ESM entrypoint and a locally bundled Three.js chunk, requested only when the hero approaches the viewport. A static fallback is available for reduced-motion preferences or browsers without WebGL.
The site uses Estedad by Amin Abedi under the SIL Open Font License 1.1.
